plan.change: new: pass 1 reader. Native header facts from the bytes (JPEG SOF/JFIF/Exif, PNG IHDR/pHYs/eXIf, TIFF IFD0 + Exif IFD): pixel size, bands, bit depth, EXIF orientation, capture time as stated, DPI as stated, georeference tags. One bounded preview (longest side 1024 px, orientation applied) through libvips (sharp): JPEG shrink-on-load, sequential line decoding, a stated pixel bound. The officer's sentence.

new: the job input, its enrolment from the batch, the settled item (state read, placement needs_answer, sentence in limit_reason, read facts and preview pointer under plan_ref.pageImage) and the officer's answer (plan, elevation, photo, other) kept as a candidate label.
new: the fenced job: read the pinned original within its byte bound, read it, store the preview derivative content-addressed beside its original's key, accept.
owned: a page image (JPEG, PNG, TIFF without georeference) goes to its reader instead of resting as kept-only.

seam: a TIFF whose first IFD has no georeference tag is family image (D1); its IFD is also read from the tail when the offset lands there. A TIFF with any georeference tag keeps its raster route (D4).
seam: register and dispatch the operation intake-page-image (one job authority).
seam: new schemas beside the others (page image read, label request); IntakeItem gains an optional pageImage view. No existing schema field changes.
seam: POST .../intake/items/:itemId/page-image-label records the officer's answer.
seam: sharp 0.35.4 as a direct dependency (already resolved in the lockfile through next; win32-x64 and linux binaries listed).

reuse: usp_intake_items row and writeIntakeDraftTx tray transitions; plan_ref already carries non-recipe item facts (existingAreaId)
jobs + claimUspJobAttempt/acceptUspJobAttempt fenced attempts, as intake-zip-layers
readObjectBounded for the original; putPartObject for the content-addressed preview
notReused: document-images.ts gated Python worker: PNG/JPEG only, 16 MiB, Windows-configured runtime, no TIFF, no bit depth or capture time; changing its contract belongs to the document recipe (G10).
needsRuntime: no: tests run the reader and the pure item words; no Docker, GPU or provider call
